description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mabodala, Minuwangoda D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510401 (23/0874)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and encumbrances) in designated locations. The content focuses on property ownership, land titles, and registration details, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
